description: This file is a script for generating plugin SDK facades, involving formatting modules, writing output, and handling command-line arguments; it orchestrates code generation based on imported modules and constants.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine operation mode (--check or --write).

methods.name: generatePluginSdkFacades
methods.description: Main function to generate plugin SDK facade modules and output, returns an array of result objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that executes the generation process, handles results, and manages process exit status.
